get.description: Server-side GIPHY search for the chat picker. Returns normalized GIF options and requires GIPHY_API_KEY to be configured.
Requires a current mutual connection. Includes current and past plans. Active future arrangements appear first, ordered by meeting time and ID.

post.description: Requires a current mutual connection. client_id makes retries safe. Times must be in the future. Sends one plan notification when created. Each successful new revision atomically writes an immutable date-plan message to the conversation and links its plan notification to that message. Retried creation does not duplicate messages. Messages support normal delivery and read receipts.

200.description: Retry of the same original proposal.

local_time.description: Local wall time without an offset. Skipped or repeated daylight-saving times are rejected.

get.description: Returns the signed-in member’s future proposed and accepted plans with current mutual connections.

patch.summary: Respond to or change a date plan
patch.description: Participants only, while still mutually connected. The current version is required. Only the invited participant may accept or decline a proposal. Either participant may cancel or reschedule an active future plan. Rescheduling requires the other participant to accept again. Stale versions return 409. Each update records history and notifies the other member. Blocking or removing a like cancels active future plans. Each successful new revision atomically writes an immutable date-plan message to the conversation and links its plan notification to that message. Retried creation does not duplicate messages. Messages support normal delivery and read receipts.

local_time.description: Local wall time without an offset. Skipped or repeated daylight-saving times are rejected.

sessionCookie.name: matcha_session
sessionCookie.description: Set automatically by POST /auth/login. Use the browser session to try authenticated endpoints.

online.description: Whether an unexpired session was active within the last 15 seconds.

latest_message_body.description: Latest message text or GIF caption. Null for conversations without messages.

latest_message_kind.description: Latest message kind. Null for conversations without messages.

plan_snapshot.description: Details at the time of this message; open the planner for the current state.

Message.description: Chat text, GIF, or a server-created immutable date-plan revision. Plan messages use kind text and include structured plan metadata; ordinary messages have null plan metadata.

message_id.description: Associated chat message for message notifications and date-plan notifications; null for other notification types and legacy plan notifications without a corresponding revision.

unread_count.description: Unread events represented by this actor/type group; zero for a read group.

latitude.description: Public area coordinate rounded to two decimal places.

longitude.description: Public area coordinate rounded to two decimal places.

tags.description: Public interests used in map member cards and viewport filters.

MessageReceipts.description: Recipient delivery and read watermarks for messages sent by the signed-in user in this conversation. Zero means no acknowledgement. A saved message is sent, an ID at or below delivered_through is delivered, and an ID at or below read_through is read.

delivered_through.description: Highest message ID acknowledged as delivered when the recipient fetches incoming messages.

read_through.description: Highest message ID acknowledged as read by the recipient. Never exceeds delivered_through.

starts_at.description: UTC instant resolved from local_time and timezone.

HTTP400.description: Malformed request or invalid, expired, or consumed link.

HTTP401.description: A valid session or correct credentials are required.

HTTP403.description: The action is forbidden for this caller or origin.

HTTP404.description: The resource is missing or unavailable to this caller.

HTTP409.description: The current account or resource state prevents this action.

HTTP413.description: The request exceeds the upload limit.

HTTP415.description: The request must use the expected media type.

HTTP429.description: The rate limit for this action was exceeded.

HTTP503.description: A dependency is temporarily unavailable or busy.
